row.title: SITE-TESTS-IN-CHECKS-1: site tests gate every change; Web Bot Auth verify parsed no parameters
row.body: site/*.test.mjs ran only in deploy-site.yml, so site/webbotauth.js verifyRequest shipped with p.indexOf("") where p.indexOf("=") was meant: every inbound Web Bot Auth signature was rejected as 'not a web-bot-auth ed25519 signature'. Fixed the parser and added the site tests to checks.yml (OL-20261115-24). Removed two unused imports (Q-SELF-unused-import).
